findings.title: Missing security header: x-content-type-options
findings.evidence: Response did not set x-content-type-options (stops the browser guessing/sniffing a response's MIME type).

findings.title: Missing security header: x-frame-options
findings.evidence: Response did not set x-frame-options (mitigates clickjacking by controlling framing).

findings.title: Missing security header: content-security-policy
findings.evidence: Response did not set content-security-policy (restricts which sources scripts/styles/etc. may load from).

findings.title: Missing security header: referrer-policy
findings.evidence: Response did not set referrer-policy (controls how much of the URL is leaked to other sites via the Referer header).

correlate.executive_summary: The assessment found several HTTP hardening issues and informational server metadata on https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com/. Missing common security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy) were observed, which increase exposure to clickjacking, MIME-type confusion, mixed-content and information-leakage risks. The host is identified as running on the Heroku platform (server header and heroku-router evidence). Nikto also reported uncommon reporting/telemetry headers (reporting-endpoints, report-to, nel) which are informational and not direct vulnerabilities. No product/service version strings were available for CVE correlation, so no CVE matches were identified for these observations.

findings.title: Missing HTTP security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy)
findings.evidence: recon: Multiple responses did not set strict-transport-security, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, content-security-policy, referrer-policy. va (nikto): The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present (nikto GET https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com:443/).

findings.title: Uncommon reporting/telemetry headers present (reporting-endpoints, report-to, nel)
findings.evidence: va (nikto): Uncommon header 'reporting-endpoints' found with heroku-nel value; 'report-to' header present with heroku-nel group and endpoints; 'nel' header present with report_to and response_headers fields (nikto GET https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com:443/).

correlate.deduplication_notes: Merged multiple recon findings about missing individual security headers into a single consolidated hardening finding (includes HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy). Merged the recon technology fingerprint (Heroku) and nikto 'heroku-router' observation into one platform identification finding. Grouped the three nikto 'uncommon header' observations (reporting-endpoints, report-to, nel) into a single informational finding about reporting/telemetry headers.
